Ys.bar_b_note: A noisy acid-lime camouflage pattern flattens the frog-lizard into one busy mid-value mass, and it barely clears the trainer's height, so it misses Palworld's clean, confident creature finish.

Wb.bar_b_note: The cyan serpent with pink fins has a bold, readable S-curve, a clear head and good scale, and holds up in the swim frame at Palworld creature finish.

Rn.bar_b_note: The spotted plesiosaur has a thin, spindly silhouette that reads weakly at small size, and faint end keeps the neck raised almost as in standing, so the KO does not read.

My.bar_b_note: The naturalistic bear with its mossy turtle shell has a grounded, believable silhouette and good scale with a rider, carried by solid fur and plate materials.

Pc.bar_b_note: A dark olive body with low value contrast sinks into the grey stage, and faint end flattens into an odd, wheel-like profile, so it falls short of Palworld readability.

Gt.bar_b_note: The barnacled crab has decent material and colour, but standing, hit react, faint mid and faint end are near-identical poses, so hurt and KO do not read.

Qk.bar_b_note: The mossy deer-steed's uniform green moss texture and scattered pale plates break the silhouette into noise, and the rider is tiny and hard to read.

Tu.bar_b_note: The teal otter has a clean, appealing silhouette, a readable pale face and chest, a legible faint and a sensible ridden scale, close to Palworld creature finish.

Wz.bar_b_note: The violet moth wings are attractive, but the creature stays upright on its legs through faint mid and faint end, so the faint does not read.

Rm.bar_b_note: The teal salamander with its cream frill has good colour and surface, but it is long and low, standing only about chest-high to the trainer, which breaks the taller-than-trainer rule and weakens its presence.

Cu.bar_b_note: The warm grandfather villager has expressive eyes, a clear silhouette and a green-and-tan palette that sits naturally in the key-art Meadows world.

Ng.bar_b_note: A's noisy yellow-spotted fur and B's smooth clay-toy terracotta both miss the board's moss-backed boar, the creature is barely trainer height on both sides, and A's faint mid floats above its shadow.

Ni.bar_b_note: A's large readable panel follows the blue-grey UI direction but wastes list space and lacks a teal interaction highlight or clear controller glyphs, and B's truncated micro-text and grey hints fall well short of Palworld UI legibility.

Up.bar_b_note: The naturalistic moss-backed hare reads instantly by its ears and silhouette, has believable fur, and its faint sequence lands grounded.

To.bar_b_note: A's braced timber frame, plank cap and stone footing make it read as a built wall, but it stands as a lone panel with flat cream infill on a uniform grass carpet, and B is a blown-out white card, so neither reaches Palworld base-building finish.

top_changes.change: Author real hit and faint animations that collapse to the ground and stay grounded (Gt, Wz and Rn barely change pose; Ng A floats in faint mid)
Scale every creature so it clearly stands taller than the 1.80 m trainer (Ys, Rm and Ng are about trainer height or lower)
Do a creature material pass: tame noisy acid or spotted patterns (Ys, Ng A, Qk moss), lift values on dark bodies (Pc) and add rim light so silhouettes separate from the ground
